## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (and the Postgres tests, if the change touches storage)
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under _Unreleased_
- [ ] Changed `skill.md`: `version:` bumped and added to the changelog's skill table
- [ ] No keys, signatures, proofs or receipts in logs or errors; agent text stays data
